text:
marta: Heads-up — us-east-1a GPU pool provisioning started failing after we flipped subnet-affinity flag this morning. Pods stuck Pending with 'attach ENI timeout' and audit-proxy shows KMS decrypt errors :eyes:

arun: saw same in staging canary ~2:30am. Looks like the affinity rules pinned instances to subnets without privatelink endpoints; the keystore service can't reach KMS via privatelink.

sec-eng: We rotated a KMS key policy last night to restrict decrypt to service principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/auditproxy-prod. Could that have overwritten the condition allowing VPC endpoint access? :thinking: 

marta: hmm, infra logs show 403 on KMS: AccessDenied for the audit-proxy role. but other services decrypt fine in same subnet

niko: firewall team also applied egress tightening — ephemeral NAT was removed from those subnets. Without NAT/privatelink the keystore's requests fail. I'm pushing rules to allow the audit-proxy SG to use NAT in that prefix.

samira: cost question — reintroducing NAT for those subnets adds ~$1.2k/month in egress. Are we okay making exception for audit logs? Could we instead route keystore traffic to a dedicated privatelink endpoint per AZ? That would be more costly on endpoints but less on NAT bandwidth.

arun: quick mitigation: can we patch the deployment to run audit-proxy in subnets with existing privatelink endpoints? podAffinity -> nodeSelector -> subnet doesn't map cleanly; might need nodePool re-labeling.

marta: trying a canary: redeployed audit-proxy into shared-keystore-subnet in us-east-1b. Initial decrypts succeeded. If that holds, we'll rollback subnet-affinity temporarily.

infra-bot: [alert] 1748123470 5 failed KMS.Decrypt attempts for audit-proxy (us-east-1a)

deploy-bot: canary deploy succeeded in us-east-1b — audit-proxy v3.2.1

sec-eng: long-term: we should update KMS key policy to allow the audit-proxy role if traffic is from privatelink endpoints or specific SG, not blanket NAT. I'll draft a policy with Condition aws:SourceVpc or aws:SourceVpce.

marta: thanks — next steps: (1) hold subnet-affinity rollout for GPU pools in us-east-1 (2) patch affinity docs to include privatelink check (3) sec-eng to share KMS policy PR (4) infra to propose least-cost routing (NAT vs per-AZ VPCe). I'll create a follow-up ticket.

arun: add me to ticket, I'll help with node labeling + warm pool scheduling.

samira: i'll run quick cost calc on NAT vs per-AZ endpoint and post results.

marta: :thumbsup:
